name: CSS - Text Styling
description: Learn to style text with font properties and sizes

rules.text: Create a heading using the <h1> tag
rules.hint: Add a heading to your HTML: <h1>My Title</h1>. Headings are important for document structure.

rules.text: Make the heading 24px in size using CSS
rules.hint: Style your heading: h1 { font-size: 24px; }. The font-size property controls how big text appears.

rules.text: Create a paragraph and make it bold and centered
rules.hint: Add <p>Some text</p> then style it: p { font-weight: bold; text-align: center; }. Font-weight controls boldness, text-align controls positioning.

completion.message: 🎉 Excellent! You can now style text like a pro!
